experiment: E17d: attribute the per-call cost the staging commit adds to MemoryManager._prefetch_provider (in place, base vs head variants), collection off and on

spec.note: Not pre-registered. Question fixed before the run: of the round-1 +47 us off-delta, the standalone record call explained 26.7 us; where is the rest?

origin_refs: E17/r20261001-03 (round-1 microbenchmark and standalone record cost)

arms.base: main's agent/memory_manager.py (blob d023a57f8b, sha256 048842c1...) loaded from source into the head tree
arms.head: the staging commit's MemoryManager
arms.head_noop: head, with shared_metrics_loop.record_memory_prefetch swapped for a no-op during the block (head - head_noop = the record call in place)
arms.head_hoisted: head source with the function-level `from hermes_cli.observability.shared_metrics_loop import record_memory_prefetch` moved to module level (head - head_hoisted = the per-call import statement)

env.sandbox: env -i; os.environ cleared, HOME/HERMES_HOME set to a fresh scratch sandbox with collection-off and collection-on profiles (send: false)
env.provider: in-process instant provider (not bundled, reports as plugin); every call takes the success exit

command: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin <read-only py3.11 venv>/bin/python work/r2/micro_attribution.py --repo <worktree at 519876fa02> --base-mm work/r2/base_memory_manager_aea969677c.py --sandbox-root <scratch> --out work/r2/micro_attribution.json

design.order: arms rotated by block index, reversed on odd blocks
design.statistic: median and p05/p95 of per-block differences (us per call)

interpretation.attribution: Collection off: head - base median +44.12 us (p05..p95 +38.33..+59.29); A/A median +0.46 (-4.69..+8.90). Swapping the record call for a no-op leaves +1.10 us (-3.84..+8.14), inside A/A, so the other edits (the function-level import, the clock read, the lock reshuffle) cost about 1 us and the record call in place costs about 44 us (head - head_noop +44.18, +33.93..+55.22). Hoisting the import changes about 4.92 us (-5.91..+16.91), inside noise. Collection on: head - base +132.50 (+114.82..+161.58), head_noop - base +6.00 (-13.11..+25.76) against A/A +4.34 (-1.82..+23.65), record call in place +128.82.
interpretation.gap: Measured alone in a tight loop, record_memory_prefetch costs 28.21 us off (enabled() alone 14.64 us) and 100.59 us on, about the same as record_execution_backend (28.58 / 98.82). In place it costs about 44 us off and 129 us on. The reason for that gap was not isolated, and the in-place cost of the existing record_* sites was not measured, so 'no worse than the existing record_* sites' holds for the standalone cost only.
interpretation.correction: Round 1's builder note said the per-call cost is the shared enabled() check. That is not supported: enabled() is about 15 us of the roughly 44 us the record call costs in place.
interpretation.gate: The selection gate 'hot-path overhead stays below noise in a microbenchmark' is NOT met: +44 us/call off and +133 us/call on against A/A p05..p95 of about -5..+9 us and -2..+24 us. Owner decision.

not_tested: the in-place cost of the existing record_* call sites
why the in-place record call costs more than the tight-loop call
other exits (only the success exit is benchmarked)
limitations: Loaded shared host (load1 about 12-13, other agents); absolute microseconds are inflated, A/A included
Different run and block count from E17's microbenchmark; the two runs agree on the head - base delta within noise (+47.05 vs +44.12 off)
verdict: KEEP (cost attribution); hot-path gate NOT MET as worded
